input:
EARLIER SCENES (context only):
古代的时候，有很多人不知道什么植物能吃，什么植物不能吃。有很多人吃植物以后就吃坏肚子了，因为他们吃了毒。那个时候，有一个老人叫神农，他什么植物都觉得好吃，不怕生病，不怕毒。他希望别人也可以吃好吃的植物。可是他知道，如果他们还怕吃毒，不会吃他喜欢的植物。
所以，他上山下山找植物，吃了很多样子的植物。他是第一人，找到了茶。他把所有的植物写下来了。他一直都吃了，他连毒都能吃。可是他还没吃了一个叫夹竹桃的植物。他找到了那个像星星的植物，觉得很漂亮，马上就吃下了。
CURRENT SCENE:
可是夹竹桃的毒很重，让他肚子很痛。他在地上躺着，觉得他快会死了。可是正好有别人找到他了，给了他一个像伞的植物，叫灵芝。他吃灵芝以后就觉得很好，不再生病了。他测量起来了，像星星的植物是毒，像伞的植物是药。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P341] 觉得【他】快会死了
  proposed by the AI checker: 觉得[他→自己]快会死了 (the subject should refer to himself)
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 觉得[-他]快会死了 (他 repeats the subject of the clause before: zero form)
  her past correction (le_completed): 快要死[+了]
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): [-他]累死了 — her note: delete他
  her past correction (conditional_jiu): 他一看[+就]觉得担心
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.

[P342] 觉得他【快会】死了
  proposed by the AI checker: 觉得他[快会→快要]死了 (快要 expresses an imminent result)
  proposed by the correction model: 觉得他快[会→要]死了
  her past correction (le_completed): 快要死[+了]
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): [-他]累死了 — her note: delete他
  her past correction (conditional_jiu): 他一看[+就]觉得担心
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.

[P343] 可是正好有【别人】找到他了
  proposed by the AI checker: 可是正好有[别人→人]找到他了 (有人 is the usual existential expression here)
  her past correction (search_find): 一个人正好[找了→找到了]神农 — her note: 找look for vs.找到find
  her past correction (other_vs_additional): 因为[别的人→有人]正好在他的旁边 — her note: “别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
  her past correction (other_vs_additional): 然后他又找到了[别的→另外一种]白花 — her note: “别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
  rule card other_vs_additional: 别的 is for a different type or for all others except the one already mentioned. 另外 is for an additional quantity, or for another/the other; say 另外一个人, not 别个人. Not an error: Do not flag 别的 when it means a different type or all others except the one already mentioned.
  rule card search_find: 找 means “look for.” Use 找到 when the person successfully finds something. Not an error: Do not use this rule when the meaning is only “look for” and does not include a successful result.

[P344] 给了他一【个】像伞的植物
  proposed by the AI checker: 给了他一[个→株]像伞的植物 (株 is the measure word for an individual plant)
  her past correction (le_completed): [给→给了]他一个灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction (le_completed): 给[+了]他一个灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction (le_completed): [吃→吃了]像伞的植物以后 — her note: 了completed
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.

[P345] 【不再生病】了
  proposed by the AI checker: [不再生病→肚子不痛]了 (the stated symptom was stomach pain, not illness)
  her past correction (other): 肚子[还没疼死了→就不疼了]
  her past correction (specific_noun_choice): [就疼死了→肚子/头就疼死了]
  her past correction (non_adjective_degree_patterns): [然后，不病→就好了] — her note: “病” is not a normal Adj., so it cannot be with 很 or 不
  rule card specific_noun_choice: Use a specific noun or noun phrase when the story needs to say exactly what person, thing, plant, experience, or problem you mean. Avoid general words such as 人、东西、事情、水果, or vague phrases such as 有麻烦. Not an error: Do not flag a general word when the context does not require a more specific meaning. This rule applies when the general word makes the story unclear or does not name what is actually meant.
  rule card non_adjective_degree_patterns: “病” and “生病” are not normal Adj., so do not use 很 or 不 directly with them. To show degree, use 病得很厉害 or 病得很重.

[P346] 他【测量起来了】
  proposed by the AI checker: 他[测量起来了→明白了] (测量 does not mean realizing toxicity)
  her past correction (resultative_complements): 他还[想起来→想得起来]
  her past correction (perception_look_see): 她[一看这→一看到这样] — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  her past correction (conditional_jiu): 他一看[+就]觉得担心
  rule card resultative_complements: Use a resultative complement when the action reaches its result: 吃到, 写下, 撞到+Obj., or 把Obj. V. Resultative complement. Not an error: Do not use 撞+Obj. when the meaning is that the object hits something else: 撞自行车 means to hit the bike.
  rule card perception_look_see: 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing. Not an error: Do not flag 看 when the meaning is only “look,” rather than successfully seeing something. 看到 does not always need 了.

[P347] 像星星的植物【是毒】
  proposed by the AI checker: 像星星的植物[是毒→有毒] (a poisonous plant is described as 有毒)
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 像星星的植物[是毒→有毒] (her pattern: 是毒 -> 有毒 (corrected 14/15 in train))
  her past correction (word_class_choice): 什么植物[是毒→有毒]
  her past correction (word_class_choice): 哪些植物是[毒→有毒]
  her past correction (word_class_choice): 特别是[毒的→有毒的]植物
  rule card word_class_choice: Choose the word class and form that the structure needs: use nouns as nouns, verbs as verbs, and Adj. where an adjective is needed. Follow fixed patterns such as 很多+noun and 这个 + Noun; 据说 goes at sentence initial, separate from the information heard. Not an error: Do not flag 文明 when it is used as an Adj. meaning “civilized.”

[P348] 像伞的【植物】是药
  proposed by the correction model: 像伞的[-植物]是药
  her past correction (incorrect_story_information): [几棵植物→有的植物]可以是药
  her past correction (word_class_choice): 特别是[毒的→有毒的]植物
  her past correction (question_patterns): [+是]药还是毒
  rule card incorrect_story_information: Use the story’s established facts when retelling it. Do not add or change people, places, actions, objects, identities, or causes; otherwise it is wrong information. Not an error: Do not flag a word or sentence under this rule only because of grammar or vocabulary. Flag it here when it changes or adds a fact in the traditional story.
  rule card word_class_choice: Choose the word class and form that the structure needs: use nouns as nouns, verbs as verbs, and Adj. where an adjective is needed. Follow fixed patterns such as 很多+noun and 这个 + Noun; 据说 goes at sentence initial, separate from the information heard. Not an error: Do not flag 文明 when it is used as an Adj. meaning “civilized.”

places.reason: Repeated subject is unnecessary after 觉得.
快要 expresses an imminent death.
有人 is needed; 别人 has no established contrast.
个 is acceptable beginner-level classifier usage.
The established symptom is stomach pain.
测量 means measure, not realize.
Plants are described as 有毒.
像伞的植物 is clear and natural.
